gloss: to push through; to part (a crowd)

definitions.gloss: to push through; to part; to shove aside
definitions.explanation: To push or sweep things aside with the hands or body in order to move forward, as through a crowd, undergrowth, or branches.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}ごみをかき{分|わ}けて{進|すす}んだ。
examples.english: I pushed through the crowd and moved forward.

examples.japanese: {草|くさ}をかき{分|わ}けて{道|みち}を{探|さが}した。
examples.english: I parted the grass and searched for the path.

examples.japanese: {記者|きしゃ}たちは{群衆|ぐんしゅう}をかき{分|わ}けて{選手|せんしゅ}に{近|ちか}づこうとした。
examples.english: The reporters tried to push through the crowd to get close to the player.

notes:
Compound of かく (to rake, to sweep) + {分|わ}ける (to divide). Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし}): the thing pushed aside is marked with を.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {人|ひと}ごみをかき{分|わ}ける: to push through a crowd
- {草木|くさき}をかき{分|わ}ける: to part the vegetation
- かき{分|わ}けて{進|すす}む: to push one's way forward
- かき{分|わ}けて{通|とお}る: to force one's way through

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {押|お}しのける: to shove aside — pushes a single obstacle out of the way, more forceful
- {掻|か}き{回|まわ}す: to stir up; to churn — the かく element, but mixing rather than parting
